question: Who is permitted to perform the oblation rite when motivated by desire?
premises: The case concerns a person motivated by desire.
The ritual context is the oblation rite.
Even a śūdra is included in this case.
inference: Even a desirous śūdra may perform the oblation rite.
plain_english: If even a śūdra is desirous, he may perform the oblation rite.
